description: A single filled area with a smooth curve showing desktop visitors over six months.
overview: The baseline area chart inside a `Card`: one series drawn as a natural curve with a light fill, a dashed horizontal grid, a month axis and a tooltip with a line indicator. There is no value axis. Press and drag across the plot to move the tooltip between months.
usage: Replace `chartData` with your records and change each `dataKey` to match your fields. Rename the series in `chartConfig` to set its label and color. The component takes no props.
